'''Clan Kelborn''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence following the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="TOR" /> When [[Jicoln Cadera]] [[Crusader's schism|rebelled]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-favoring reign of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> Clan Kelborn was one of several clans that rallied to Cadera's side. Cadera and [[Clan Cadera|his clan's]] movement was defeated, Clan Kelborn was accepted back by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], and continued to be a respected part of the Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TOR" />

[[Merrk Kelborn]] served as a [[Rally Master]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and could often be found at the [[Mandalorian enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Kelborn was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" /> The clan shares its name with the character [[Kelborn]] from Obsidian's game, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.
